name: @leclabs/agent-factory
description: agent-factory — the canonical culture (agent-canon) and projection machinery (agent-forge) from which agent societies are founded.

scripts.canon:deploy:agent: node packages/agent-forge/dist/cli/index.js deploy --kind agent --agents-dir packages/agent-canon/.render-ts/agents --skills-dir packages/agent-canon/.render-ts/skills
scripts.canon:deploy:skill: node packages/agent-forge/dist/cli/index.js deploy --kind skill --agents-dir packages/agent-canon/.render-ts/agents --skills-dir packages/agent-canon/.render-ts/skills
scripts.canon:deploy: pnpm build && pnpm canon:project && node packages/agent-forge/dist/cli/index.js deploy --agents-dir packages/agent-canon/.render-ts/agents --skills-dir packages/agent-canon/.render-ts/skills --hooks-dir packages/agent-canon/.render-ts
